D: A process server and his dealer go on the run after witnessing a murder, armed with nothing but a rare strain called Pineapple Express.
P: Serve the snacks when Dale and Saul hit the road.
S: Charred pineapple salsa with lime chips
Grilled pineapple, red onion and jalapeño salsa with lime corn chips

Pineapple charred on a hot grill and chopped with red onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime, served with corn chips dusted in lime salt. Cut half a pineapple into thick slices and char on a very hot grill pan for 3 minutes a side. Cool and dice. Mix with half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, a handful of chopped coriander, the juice of 2 limes and salt. Rest 10 minutes. Toss 250g corn chips with the zest of 1 lime and half a tsp salt and serve with the salsa.
Cob loaf stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and parmesan

A cob loaf cut into a crosshatch and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and parmesan, baked until crisp and stringy, for pulling apart on the couch. Heat the oven to 190C. Cut a cob loaf in a crosshatch pattern, 2cm apart, without cutting through the base. Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Spoon into all the cuts, then stuff with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g parmesan. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes until golden and melted.
M: Grilled teriyaki chicken thighs with charred pineapple and rice

Chicken thighs glazed in homemade teriyaki and chargrilled with thick pineapple slices, served over rice with sesame, spring onion and pickled chilli. Simmer 100ml soy, 60ml mirin, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove for 5 minutes until syrupy. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in half the sauce for 30 minutes. Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce. Grill 8 pineapple slices 2 minutes a side. Cook 1.5 cups rice. Slice the chicken and serve with pineapple, sesame, spring onion and sliced chilli in vinegar.
W: Pineapple rings baked in rum brown sugar butter under a sponge

Buttery cake baked over fresh pineapple and a dark rum brown sugar caramel, turned out warm with coconut cream for pouring. Heat the oven to 180C. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum in a 23cm tin and lay 8 fresh pineapple rings on top. Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and turn out. Serve warm with 200ml chilled coconut cream.
K: White rum, pineapple juice, mint and lime over crushed ice

Fresh pineapple muddled with lime, mint and brown sugar, shaken with white rum and poured over crushed ice with a chilli salt rim. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder and rim 4 glasses. For each drink, muddle 4 pineapple chunks, 4 mint leaves, 15ml brown sugar syrup and 20ml lime juice in a shaker. Add 45ml white rum and 60ml pineapple juice, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice. For non-drinkers, skip the rum and top with soda.
